info.description: Searches the Department of Justice press releases. The version value is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version. The documentation does not specify authentication.
info.title: Department of Justice - Press Releases

get.description: Returns press releases in the requested language. If start and end are omitted, press releases from the last six months are returned. All times are in HKT (GMT+8). A maximum of 400 records will be returned. The documented examples use English (lang=en); catalog resources also list Traditional Chinese (tc) and Simplified Chinese (sc).

parameters.description: Official identifier, fixed to SJ in the documented request URL.
parameters.name: official

parameters.description: Press release type, fixed to press in the documented request URL.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Response language. English is documented in the API URL; catalog resources also list tc (Traditional Chinese) and sc (Simplified Chinese).
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Inclusive start date in YYYYMMDD format, for example 20190102. Earliest accepted date is 01 July 2017. Must be used together with end.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Inclusive end date in YYYYMMDD format, for example 20190109. The latest accepted date is today. Must be used together with start.
parameters.name: end

200.description: Successful search. The documentation describes the API fields but does not specify the top-level response envelope.
